preamble: Fronting of the open-mid back unrounded vowel [ʌ] to the open-mid front [ɛ] is attested as part of the California Vowel Shift, where the STRUT vowel moves forward through [ɜ] and approaches [ɛ], so that fun comes to sound like fen and but like bet. The change is a regional, ongoing development within one variety of American English.

examples.note: In the California Vowel Shift STRUT /ʌ/ moves through [ɜ] and approaches [ɛ]; Eckert gives fun sounding like fen.
Eckert describes the vowel of but, rust, bun as shifting towards the vowels of bet, rest, Ben.

sources: Eckert, P. (2008). Vowel shifts in Northern California and the Detroit suburbs. https://web.stanford.edu/~eckert/vowels.html
